title: Frontend: Cards Carousel
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Cards Carousel. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App({items=[Alpha,Beta,Gamma]}), a cards carousel using title strings and local one-pixel images with alt=title. slides container [data-testid=slides] contains up to two articles with h2 titles. Next/Previous use data-action=next/previous. Navigation clamps at valid start indices. Empty items renders No images.  This exercise focuses selection/window semantics rather than remote image loading.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Track a start index and derive the visible slice from item count and measured cards-per-view.
alternativeApproaches: Add virtualized card rendering and preserve focus when a previously visible card moves offscreen.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Fewer items than slots; final partial group; resize.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
